about: The quests (web/systems/quests.js). A quest is given by a person of npcs.json (npc) and goes through its steps in order. A step is one of: talk (the lines the person says, then a button that goes to the next step), kill (a number of monsters of an id of assets/monsters/monsters.json; the person says waiting while it is not done), goal (a text on the screen; the person says waiting). title: shown on the screen while the quest runs.

talk: Oh, a traveller! Please, help me!
Aibatts came out of the cave in the mountain. There are so many of them now.
They fly around my house all day. Kill 10 of them for me!

waiting: There are still Aibatts everywhere. Please kill 10 of them!

talk: Thank you! But look... more of them keep coming.
They all come from the cave in the mountain, behind my house.
Their leader, the Captain Aibatt, lives deep in the cave. Defeat it, and the Aibatts will stop!
steps.button: I will go to the cave

steps.goal: Defeat the Captain Aibatt in the cave
waiting: The cave is in the mountain, behind my house. The Captain Aibatt is at the far end. Be careful!

talk: You defeated the Captain Aibatt? Wonderful!
No more Aibatts will come out of the cave. My house is safe again.
Thank you, traveller. Come back and see me any time!
